comparison_scope.description: Original versus enriched V14 fixed-bank validation reports; read-only analysis of reports, not model or policy changes.

protocol.name: split_world_parity_v1
protocol.rule: even sample_index = selection; odd sample_index = evaluation; disjoint halves, no same-world fallback
protocol.selection: mean P(clear) on even indices only
protocol.evaluation: raw Bernoulli mean on odd indices only
protocol.seed_check: unique seeds per arm; shared cross-arm seeds must have the same index; halves disjoint

comparison_scope.matched_estimand: Decision-weighted mean of (enriched choice_weights - original choice_weights) dot common evaluation_values.
comparison_scope.baseline_advantage: Reported model_value minus anchor_value; not model versus model and not full-run win rate.
comparison_scope.quantile_coverage_note: Quantiles.coverage is empirical quantile coverage, distinct from candidate coverage; nominal levels and intervals retained.

schema_verification.identity_scope_caveat: Exact overlap verified for all 2981 retained paired records and their strata. The 51 excluded decisions have no paired identities; equality of their identities cannot be established from aggregate counts. No explicit per-arm action IDs are carried in paired records; common array ordering is supported by exact evaluation-vector equality and common report dataset/protocol, not independently audited from raw data.

verdicts.ci_overlap_interpretation: Marginal CI overlap and point containment are descriptive, not a matched model-difference test.
verdicts.recommendation: Neither is separable on matched validation value. If one must be frozen for an independent test gate, carry original as a tuning choice: higher advantage, pairwise, top1/top3 and lower regret; enriched has slightly lower Brier. No test result or superiority claim.

reported_reasons: validation split is tuning evidence, not an independent test gate

paired.exclusion_rule: complete verified world splits only; censored selection or unknown/censored evaluation excludes the decision; selection labels and evaluation predictions unused
paired.tie_rule: uniform prediction argmax ties; all label maxima accepted; no SE gap filtering
paired.selection_rule: even sample_index = selection; odd sample_index = evaluation; disjoint halves, no same-world fallback

quantiles.comparison_space: log1p raw score/target; monotone transform preserves coverage; no ratio clipping

candidate_coverage.reference: extended finite-sample optimistic proxy, not a legal-action oracle

reported_limitations_verbatim: supported observable domain only; root eligibility requires collector summary
no fresh-bank claim without provenance audit
small-K reference maxima are optimistic and noisy
prediction ties use uniform randomization expectation, not outcome-informed tie-breaking
calibration uses individual raw Bernoulli trials; ranking uses trial-mean probabilities
all candidate decisions containing censored/missing arms excluded, not silently reranked
HistGBM has only a clear head; unavailable auxiliary diagnostics remain null
Gate 3 verdict is not certification of collector Gate 1 or live-policy improvement

bootstrap.resampling: Draw 212 seeds with replacement per replicate; include every decision of each sampled seed with its multiplicity.
bootstrap.statistic: Sum sampled seed delta totals / sum sampled seed decision counts; not unweighted mean of seed means.

matched_delta.disagreement_definition: Choice-weight vectors differ by exact array equality; gained/lost/tied classifies enriched-minus-original value using tolerance 1e-12.

by_ante.selection_rule: Descriptive extrema of enriched-minus-original advantage among nonempty, non-tie strata; no multiplicity-adjusted inference.

by_gap.selection_rule: Descriptive extrema of enriched-minus-original advantage among nonempty, non-tie strata; no multiplicity-adjusted inference.

sample_sizes.gate_bar_context: Only 212 seed clusters (172 informative), not 238824 independent trials. This is limited evidence for a decisive test gate, but exceeds the reports' actual minimum of 30 informative seeds and 200 informative decisions (observed 760). No larger numeric gate bar is specified in these reports; do not claim a sample-size threshold failure.

limitations: Validation is tuning/model-selection evidence, not independent test-gate evidence; no test-split data were read.
The matched 95% CI spans zero: no significance or model-superiority claim; absence of separation is not proof of equivalence.
Small seed count relative to a decisive gate: 212 clusters, 172 informative; reported numerical minima are nevertheless met. More bootstrap replicates do not add independent evidence.

Cluster bootstrap preserves within-seed dependence and weights decisions equally. It conditions on fitted models and observed evaluation trial means, without refitting models or resampling evaluation worlds.
2221 of 2981 paired decisions have null action-value differences; top1/top3 include these ties and are not informative-only ranking rates.
51 decisions are excluded from paired ranking; 3026 trials are censored/unknown. Calibration uses 238824 usable raw trials and is not restricted to the exact paired-ranking population.
Candidate coverage was not measured (zero decisions); terminal heads have zero observations, so terminal performance and full-run win rate cannot be inferred.
Stratum highlights and Brier differences are descriptive; no matched Brier interval or multiplicity correction was computed.
Freshness, raw world/arm identity and train/validation/test disjointness were not independently audited; only report-level paired validation identity overlap was verified.
Source limitations are preserved verbatim; the generic HistGBM clear-head limitation is not treated as proof of these models' architecture.
